const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { pythonValue } = require('./python');
const { runBatchEntry, definitionInstantiate, definitionInspect, validateBatchMode, readBatchSummary } = require('./batch');
const { failedOutcome } = require('./outcome');
const dataImport = require('./data-import');
const entityQuery = require('./entity-query');
const sketch = require('./sketch');
const datum = require('./datum');
const curve = require('./curve');
const surface = require('./surface');
const reference = require('./reference');
const drawingPackage = require('./drawing-package');
const drawingCheck = require('./drawing-check');
const drawingExport = require('./drawing-export');
const spring = require('./spring');
const thread = require('./thread');
const cam = require('./cam');
const seal = require('./seal');
const fastener = require('./fastener');
const featureRework = require('./feature-rework');
const ui = require('./ui');
const referencesRefresh = require('./references-refresh');
const externalization = require('./externalization');
const documentPublication = require('./document-publication');

const catalog = { ...dataImport.descriptors, ...curve.descriptors, ...surface.descriptors, ...spring.descriptors, ...thread.descriptors, ...cam.descriptors, ...seal.descriptors, ...fastener.descriptors, ...drawingPackage.descriptors, ...drawingCheck.descriptors, ...drawingExport.descriptors };
for (const file of fs.readdirSync(path.join(__dirname, 'catalog')).sort()) {
  if (!file.endsWith('.json')) continue;
  for (const [operation, entry] of Object.entries(require('./catalog/' + file))) {
    if (catalog[operation]) throw new Error('Duplicate CAD operation: ' + operation);
    catalog[operation] = entry;
  }
}
datum.configure(catalog);
surface.configure(catalog);
reference.configure(catalog);
referencesRefresh.configure(catalog);

function validateCad(operation, data) {
  const entry = catalog[operation];
  if (!entry) throw new Error('Unknown CAD operation: ' + operation);
  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data)) throw new Error('CAD data must be an object');
  const missing = entry.required.filter((key) => !Object.hasOwn(data, key));
  if (missing.length) throw new Error('Missing CAD inputs: ' + missing.join(', '));
  const unknown = Object.keys(data).filter((key) => !Object.hasOwn(entry.inputs, key));
  if (unknown.length) throw new Error('Unknown CAD inputs: ' + unknown.join(', '));
  ui.validate(operation, data);
  referencesRefresh.validate(data, operation);
  documentPublication.validate(operation, data);
  if (operation === 'component.externalize') externalization.validate(data);
  if (operation === 'batch.reconcile') {
    if (data.operations !== undefined && (!Array.isArray(data.operations) || data.operations.length > 100 ||
        data.operations.some(item => !item || typeof item !== 'object' || Array.isArray(item) ||
          Object.keys(item).some(key => !['operation', 'data'].includes(key)) ||
          typeof item.operation !== 'string' || !item.data || typeof item.data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(item.data)))) {
      throw new Error('batch reconcile operations must be an array of at most 100 {operation,data} objects');
    }
  }
  if (operation === 'definition.instantiate') validateBatchMode(data);
  featureRework.validate(operation, data);
  if (entry.dataImport) dataImport.prepare(operation, data);
  entityQuery.validate(operation, data);
  sketch.validate(operation, data);
  datum.validate(operation, data);
  curve.validate(operation, data);
  surface.validate(operation, data);
  reference.validate(operation, data);
  drawingPackage.validate(operation, data);
  drawingCheck.validate(operation, data);
  drawingExport.validate(operation, data);
  spring.validate(operation, data);
  thread.validate(operation, data);
  cam.validate(operation, data);
  seal.validate(operation, data);
  fastener.validate(operation, data);
  return entry;
}

function fusionPath(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') throw new Error('File path must be a string');
  if (/^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]|^\\\\/.test(value)) return value;
  const absolute = path.resolve(value);
  const drive = absolute.match(/^\/mnt\/([a-zA-Z])\/(.*)$/);
  if (drive) return drive[1].toUpperCase() + ':\\' + drive[2].replaceAll('/', '\\');
  if (process.platform === 'win32' || process.platform === 'darwin') return absolute;
  return '\\\\wsl$\\' + (process.env.WSL_DISTRO_NAME || 'Ubuntu') + absolute.replaceAll('/', '\\');
}

function mapCadPaths(operation, data) {
  const out = structuredClone(data);
  if (operation.startsWith('export.') || operation.startsWith('checkpoint.') || operation === 'import.file') {
    if (out.path) out.path = fusionPath(out.path);
    if (out.directory) out.directory = fusionPath(out.directory);
    if (out.parts) for (const part of out.parts) part.path = fusionPath(part.path);
  }
  if (operation === 'shot.pack') for (const shot of out.shots) shot.path = fusionPath(shot.path);
  if (operation === 'view.compare') for (const field of ['left', 'right']) out[field] = fusionPath(out[field]);
  if (operation === 'texture.heightmap' && out.path) out.path = fusionPath(out.path);
  if (['motion.sample', 'animation.joints', 'explode.render'].includes(operation)) {
    if (out.directory) out.directory = fusionPath(out.directory);
    if (out.frameFiles) out.frameFiles = out.frameFiles.map(fusionPath);
  }
  if (operation === 'animation.export') {
    if (out.frames) out.frames = out.frames.map(fusionPath);
    if (out.output) out.output = fusionPath(out.output);
  }
  return out;
}

function buildCadScript(operation, data, context) {
  const entry = validateCad(operation, data);
  if (entry.curve) data = curve.prepare(operation, data);
  if (entry.dataImport) {
    data = dataImport.prepare(operation, data);
    const models = operation === 'cots.replace' ? [data.result.model] : (data.result.items || []).map(r => r.model).filter(Boolean);
    for (const model of models) model.fusionPath = fusionPath(model.path);
  }
  const dir = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'assets', 'cad');
  // Keep the existing identity/context implementation, but do not transmit the
  // entire modeling library for a document-only read. Explicit component scopes
  // retain the full resolver contract. No target activation or retry is added.
  const lightStatus = operation === 'document.status' && context.component == null;
  const files = lightStatus ? ['core.py', 'identity.py', 'document_snapshot.py'] :
    ['core.py', ...fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.py') && f !== 'core.py').sort()];
  let source = files.map(f => fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, f), 'utf8')).join('\n\n');
  if (lightStatus) source += '\n\ndef _document_status_minimal(ctx, data):\n    _cad_fields(data)\n    return _document_snapshot(ctx.doc)\n\nCAD_HANDLERS["document.status"] = _document_status_minimal\n';
  const request = { operation, data: mapCadPaths(operation, data), doc: context.doc, component: context.component, projectId: context.projectId,
    docId: context.docId, docFileId: context.docFileId };
  return source + `\n\n_FMCAD_REQUEST = ${pythonValue(request)}

def run(_context: str):
    # Fail before touching Fusion if the host has leaked nested output wrappers.
    # Keep all host sanitization in place; never replace or unwrap the streams.
    import sys
    for stream in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
        seen = set()
        while type(stream).__name__ == '_NsSanitizedWriter':
            if id(stream) in seen or len(seen) >= 64:
                raise RuntimeError('FMCAD_MCP_STREAM_EXHAUSTED: the host has accumulated nested sanitized output writers. No CAD operation was started. Restart or repair the MCP add-in; output filtering has not been changed.')
            seen.add(id(stream))
            stream = object.__getattribute__(stream, '__dict__')['_original']
    request = _FMCAD_REQUEST
    ctx = CadContext(request['doc'], request.get('component'), request.get('projectId'), request.get('docId'), request.get('docFileId'))
    if ${entry.readOnly || operation === 'document.clear' || operation === 'document.save_native' || operation === 'selection.highlight' || operation.startsWith('camera.') && operation !== 'camera.set' || operation === 'shot.pack' ? 'False' : 'True'}:
        ctx.activate_target()
    ctx.assert_identity()
    print('FMCAD_PROGRESS ' + json.dumps({'operation': request['operation'], 'document': ctx.doc.name, 'state': 'started'}))
    result = ctx.call(request['operation'], request['data'])
    success = not (isinstance(result, dict) and (result.get('passed') is False or (result.get('restored') is False and result.get('leftRequestedState') is not True and result.get('status') != 'pass') or result.get('sampledPassed') is False or result.get('checkOutcome') == 'fail' or result.get('status') in ('fail', 'failed', 'blocked', 'unknown', 'missing', 'stale')))
    print('FMCAD_RESULT ' + json.dumps(_cad_json({'success': success, 'operation': request['operation'], 'document': ctx.doc.name, 'result': result, 'created': ctx.created}), allow_nan=False))
`;
}

async function executeCad(client, operation, data, context) {
  const entry = validateCad(operation, data);
  if (entry.curve && context.preview) return { success: true, status: 'notEvaluated', operation, mutation: false,
    plan: curve.prepare(operation, data), limitations: ['Input preflight only; native geometry and kernel not evaluated.'] };
  if (entry.dataImport && (context.preview || dataImport.isOffline(operation, data))) return dataImport.offlineResult(dataImport.prepare(operation, data), !!context.preview);
  if (entry.definitionMode) return definitionInspect(data, catalog, operation);
  if (context.preview && (operation === 'definition.instantiate' || entry.batchMode)) {
    const result = operation === 'definition.instantiate'
      ? await definitionInstantiate(client, data, context, executeCad, catalog)
      : await runBatchEntry(client, { ...data, mode: entry.batchMode }, context, executeCad, catalog);
    return { ...result, mutation: false };
  }
  if (context.preview) return { success: true, operation, state: 'input-validated-only', mutation: false,
    document: context.doc, data, limitations: ['Entity resolution and kernel feasibility not tested.',
      sketch.validates(operation) ? 'GM06 nested input shapes and expression-string syntax checked; Fusion expressions, entity selectors and solver feasibility remain unvalidated.' :
        'Only outer payload keys and unconditional required-key presence checked; nested schemas/types, conditional fields, units and supported mode values are not validated.',
      ...(entry.offline ? ['No stored report was read or validated.'] : [])] };
  if (entry.nodeOnly) {
    if (ui.operations.includes(operation)) return ui.execute(client, operation, data, context);
    if (documentPublication.OPERATIONS.includes(operation)) {
      return documentPublication.execute(client, operation, data, context, executeCad);
    }
    if (operation === 'component.externalize') return externalization.execute(client, data, context, {
      step: (action, payload, readOnly) => executeExternalizationAction(client, action, payload, readOnly),
      refresh: request => executeCad(client, 'references.refresh', request, {}),
    });
    if (operation === 'references.refresh') return referencesRefresh.execute(client, data, context, {
      step: (action, payload, input, targetContext) => executeReferencesAction(client, action, payload, input, targetContext),
      inspectUi: (targetClient, request, targetContext) => {
        ui.validate('ui.inspect', request);
        return ui.execute(targetClient, 'ui.inspect', request, targetContext);
      },
      armWatcher: (targetClient, request) => ui.armWatcher(targetClient, request),
      backend: client?.capabilities?.backend ?? null,
    });
    if (reference.descriptors[operation]) return reference.execute(operation, data);
    if (drawingPackage.descriptors[operation]) return drawingPackage.execute(operation, data);
    if (drawingCheck.descriptors[operation]) return drawingCheck.execute(operation, data);
    if (drawingExport.descriptors[operation]) return drawingExport.execute(operation, data);
    if (operation === 'batch.summary') return readBatchSummary(data);
    if (operation === 'batch.reconcile' || operation === 'batch.finalize') {
      const atomic = require('./batch-atomic');
      atomic.setObserveReadOnlyCatalog(catalog);
      if (!client) throw new Error(`${operation} requires the selected addin backend; no offline result is available`);
      if (operation === 'batch.reconcile') return atomic.reconcileAtomicBatch(client, data.reportPath, data.operations ?? []);
      return atomic.finalizeAtomicBatch(client, data.reportPath);
    }
    if (operation === 'definition.instantiate') return definitionInstantiate(client, data, context, executeCad, catalog);
    if (entry.batchMode) return runBatchEntry(client, { ...data, mode: entry.batchMode }, context, executeCad, catalog);
    throw new Error('Unknown Node-only CAD operation: ' + operation);
  }
  const script = buildCadScript(operation, data, context);
  const out = await client.callTool({ featureType: 'script', object: { script,
    readOnly: entry.readOnly || (operation === 'document.clear' && data.dryRun === true) } });
  const text = out.text || '';
  const resultLine = text.split(/\r?\n/).find(line => line.startsWith('FMCAD_RESULT '));
  if (out.failed || !resultLine) {
    throw new Error(`${operation} failed; model may contain partial changes. Inspect before retry. ${text}`);
  }
  const output = JSON.parse(resultLine.slice('FMCAD_RESULT '.length));
  if (failedOutcome(output)) output.success = false;
  if (entry.dataImport || (output.result?.schemaVersion === 1 && /^(entity|datum|joint|occurrence)\./.test(operation))) {
    for (const key of ['status', 'documentIdentity', 'units', 'frame', 'associativity', 'warnings', 'method', 'limitations', 'provenance']) {
      if (output.result && Object.hasOwn(output.result, key)) output[key] = output.result[key];
    }
    output.affected = output.result?.affected || output.result?.occurrenceMap || output.result?.poses || output.result?.instances || output.result?.parameters || [];
  }
  if ((operation.startsWith('sketch.') || entry.curve || entry.surface || entry.envelope || data.solid === false) && output.result?.schemaVersion === 1) {
    for (const key of ['status', 'documentIdentity', 'units', 'frame', 'associativity', 'warnings', 'method', 'limitations', 'provenance', 'affected']) {
      if (Object.hasOwn(output.result, key)) output[key] = output.result[key];
    }
  }
  return output;
}

const REFERENCE_READ_ACTIONS = new Set(['graph', 'preflight']);
function buildReferencesActionScript(action, data) {
  if (!['graph', 'preflight', 'sdkUpdate', 'nativeUpdate', 'save', 'coldVerify'].includes(action)) {
    throw new Error('Unsupported internal references.refresh SDK action');
  }
  const dir = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'assets', 'cad');
  const files = ['core.py', ...fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.py') && f !== 'core.py').sort()];
  const source = files.map(f => fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, f), 'utf8')).join('\n\n');
  const request = pythonValue({ action, data });
  return source + `\n\n_FMCAD_REFERENCE_REQUEST = ${request}\ndef run(_context: str):\n    import json\n    _request = _FMCAD_REFERENCE_REQUEST\n    _result = _references_refresh_internal(_request['action'], _request['data'])\n    print('FMCAD_RESULT ' + json.dumps(_cad_json(_result), allow_nan=False))\n`;
}

async function executeReferencesAction(client, action, data, input) {
  if (!client) throw new Error(`references.refresh ${action} requires the selected Fusion backend`);
  const scriptData = { ...data };
  const nativeRpcTimeoutMs = action === 'nativeUpdate' ? scriptData.nativeRpcTimeoutMs : null;
  delete scriptData.nativeRpcTimeoutMs;
  const script = buildReferencesActionScript(action, scriptData);
  const readOnly = REFERENCE_READ_ACTIONS.has(action) && (input.lifecycle ?? 'existingOnly') === 'existingOnly';
  const server = client.server;
  const previousTimeoutMs = server?.timeoutMs;
  const timeoutAdjusted = Number.isFinite(nativeRpcTimeoutMs) && nativeRpcTimeoutMs > 0 &&
    server && Number.isFinite(previousTimeoutMs);
  if (timeoutAdjusted) server.timeoutMs = Math.min(previousTimeoutMs, nativeRpcTimeoutMs);
  let output;
  try {
    output = await client.callTool({ featureType: 'script', object: { script, readOnly } });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = String(error?.message ?? error);
    if (message.includes('RPC not submitted:')) return { status: 'notStarted', notStarted: true, error: message };
    error.unknown = true;
    throw error;
  } finally {
    if (timeoutAdjusted) server.timeoutMs = previousTimeoutMs;
  }
  if (output.uiGuard?.notStarted === true) return { status: 'blocked', notStarted: true,
    activeCommand: output.uiGuard.activeCommand ?? null, error: output.text ?? 'Fusion command preflight rejected the script before user code.' };
  const line = String(output.text ?? '').split(/\r?\n/).find(value => value.startsWith('FMCAD_RESULT '));
  if (output.failed || !line) {
    const message = String(output.text ?? '');
    if (message.includes('RPC not submitted:')) return { status: 'notStarted', notStarted: true, error: message };
    const error = new Error(`references.refresh ${action} failed; inspect before retry. ${message}`);
    error.unknown = true;
    throw error;
  }
  return JSON.parse(line.slice('FMCAD_RESULT '.length));
}

async function executeExternalizationAction(client, action, data, readOnly) {
  if (!client) throw new Error('component.externalize requires the selected Fusion backend');
  if (!['inspect','perform'].includes(action)) throw new Error('Invalid private externalization action');
  const dir = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'assets', 'cad');
  const files = ['core.py', ...fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.py') && f !== 'core.py').sort()];
  const source = files.map(f => fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, f), 'utf8')).join('\n\n');
  const previous = client.server?.timeoutMs;
  const scriptData={...data,copyRpcBudgetMs:Math.min(previous ?? 180000,data.remainingMs ?? 180000)};
  const script = source + `\n_EXTERNAL_REQUEST = ${pythonValue({action,data:scriptData})}\ndef run(_context):\n    _result = _external_refresh_internal(_EXTERNAL_REQUEST['action'], _EXTERNAL_REQUEST['data'])\n    print('FMCAD_RESULT ' + json.dumps(_cad_json(_result), allow_nan=False))\n`;
  if (Number.isFinite(data.remainingMs) && data.remainingMs < 1000) return {status:'pending',
    receipt:{cursor:0,reason:'budgetExhausted',stopReason:'budgetExhausted'},notStarted:true};
  if (client.server && Number.isFinite(data.remainingMs)) client.server.timeoutMs = Math.min(previous ?? 180000, data.remainingMs);
  try {
    const output = await client.callTool({featureType:'script',object:{script,readOnly:action==='inspect' && readOnly===true}});
    if(output.uiGuard?.notStarted)return {status:'blocked',notStarted:true,receipt:{cursor:0,reason:'interactiveCommandActive'}};
    const line=String(output.text ?? '').split(/\r?\n/).find(row=>row.startsWith('FMCAD_RESULT '));
    if(output.failed || !line)throw new Error('External native outcome unknown; inspect existing operation. '+(output.text ?? ''));
    return JSON.parse(line.slice('FMCAD_RESULT '.length));
  } finally { if(client.server) {if(previous===undefined)delete client.server.timeoutMs;else client.server.timeoutMs=previous;} }
}

module.exports = { catalog, validateCad, buildCadScript, buildReferencesActionScript, executeReferencesAction, executeExternalizationAction,
  executeCad, mapCadPaths };
